reviews.title: Not what it used to be
reviews.text: This used to be a good app but recently it’s been running slow and hanging. Now it just fails to load any stories and shows a spinning cursor on a blank screen.

reviews.title: Burning battery
reviews.text: Love the app in general but today it used 41% of my battery in the background! I’m sure it’s a bug so I’ll be sure to remove this bad review when fixed.

reviews.title: Strongly Biased
reviews.text: The situation in the Middle East is ancient, layered, and complex. The Guardian’s reporting is simplistic, following its own narrative. This is not helpful or informative. I’ve found better, more balanced news sources. Epoch Times and Christian Science Monitor, for example, get higher marks from 3rd party evaluators.

reviews.title: Often freezes
reviews.text:
Often freezes and remains blank for up to 10 seconds when trying to load a page. iPadOS 27 on M1.

Update: 10/26 worked for a while, now much worse than ever

reviews.title: Used to be great…….
reviews.text:
Long time guardian reader. Journalism is still top notch but the the app is increasingly sticky and slow to respond. This is particularly noticeable following the abysmal ‘upgrade’ to the crosswords which are now practically unplayable on iPad. I’ve contacted support and understand that much of this upgrade was around accessibility for visually impaired, however I’m not convinced this was the best way of tackling the issue. I suspect whoever designed to upgrade didn’t do crosswords.

Seriously considering cancelling subscription if improvements aren’t made.

Update Deleting and reinstalling seems to temporarily fix the time lags, but it also clears any history, including crosswords which is a pain. Come on Guardian you can do better than this

reviews.title: What is going on here?
reviews.text:
Using this is like wading through treacle.

It can sit for many seconds if you change tab with no visual indication.  Scrolling is sticky and jumpy especially if you are scrolling past video content (I do not have videos autoplaying).

Please, please, fix it already.

reviews.title: Crashing on iPhone
reviews.text: Is the app being sabotaged or something? I open it on my iPhone, it stays open for a second then crashes and shuts down.

reviews.title: Shameful
reviews.text:
Why is the Guardian so Left-Wing, Coming across as anti British 
Also We are still in Europe, Luckily not in the european union, the eu also comes across as anti British The guardian propaganda should be held accountable.

reviews.title: Crossword Ruined
reviews.text: The changes to the crossword have ruined it. It’s the main reason I have the app. The news is better on the Web app. Unless it goes back I’ll probably end up deleting it.

reviews.title: The app gets worse and worse
reviews.text:
Not only can’t I select the news I want to see, they now push a load of minutiae at the top like a tabloid. I have to scroll past tons of sports news which is always in great depth on he home page but I can’t get to the news that actually mattes without having to dig around.  

This would be an easy tweak to make to revert to the old style app which was much better but the developers would rather ignore subscribers.  

It doesn’t automatically download news so keeps searching when I’m on the tube. Like the app, the journalism has also deteriorated of late as they chase scandals for eyeballs rather than focusing on quality journalism.

reviews.title: Background process 100% battery
reviews.text: Any app that’s goes through the whole battery overnight whilst charging has to go no matter what you think of the content.

reviews.title: Broken Crosswords
reviews.text: Recent update completely broke crosswords. They no longer “solve”, selecting down clues isn’t possible and the amount of times you end up writing in the middle of another word is tedious.

reviews.title: App keeps closing
reviews.text: As of the update 2 days ago the app won’t stay open on my iPhone 15 Pro. I’ve tried reinstalling with no success.

reviews.title: Latest update is awful
reviews.text: Only really use the app for crosswords. Used to have a subscription but couldn’t afford to keep it; fortunately the crosswords are included with the non-subscribed app. Silly to limit the number of articles you can view when you can view them all on social media and online. But my issue is with the latest update - it’s rendered the crosswords horrible to use. The setter’s name is hidden and it’s all off-colour. Just a massive disimprovement on a feature that did not need changing.

reviews.title: Murderers
reviews.text: Hounded a black man to un-alive himself

reviews.title: Signing in.
reviews.text:
Yet again the damn app wants me to sign in. The Guardian line on this is that it wants to test reader response to being asked to sign in in. (What?).
OK, so here’s my response: it’s a bloody nuisance and a breach of contract. I pay for this subscription, so when you block my access you are in breach of contract. 
Since Rusbridger left there has been a considerable decline in the quality of writing and in the impact of the journalism. Your competitors (Byline Times, for instance) are braver, more inquisitive, and just get on with delivering the journalism.

reviews.title: Drains battery
reviews.text: The app ran in the background at night without me opening the app or touching my phone. It ran in the background for more than 3 hours and totally drained the battery

reviews.title: App vanished
reviews.text:
I cannot delete the app as it has vanished from my screen. If I search for it in apps all it shows is “open”
How to delete the app?

reviews.title: Don’t update!
reviews.text: Latest update makes my phone hot and drains the battery, avoid the latest update!

reviews.title: Hot phone and battery drain
reviews.text: This app made my phone warm and rapidly drained the battery while running in the background.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: My rating is given not to the Apple part of the app but to the Guardian.  I clarified with the Guardian helpdesk before taking out a subscription that it could be used by my family on different devices at different addresses.  I was told yes through the Guardian website.  I made the error of doing it through the app on my iPad, after constant prompting by the Guardian to support them.  Total lack of transparency from the Guardian when subscribing via their app that there were other ways and levels to subscribe.  Thankfully Apple very quickly refunded my subscription.

reviews.title: Lefty nonsense
reviews.text: Deleting this app. Just about had enough of the wokery which is so irrelevant to the way things are in the UK now.

reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text: Not a bad app but too many annoyances. Free version is almost unusable

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: There is no need to require an account to read an article.

reviews.title: Log in issues
reviews.text: Beautiful app but I have to log in to the site before I can do so on the app. Amateur design

reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text: The free version of the app is basically unusable because of the limits. The subscription in my opinion is too expensive and it excludes so many people who can’t afford to spare £15 a month for this. Would be great to have tiered accounts with more ads for cheaper subscriptions.

reviews.title: Over engineering the app
reviews.text: The recent update has caused a number of issues, including the lost of always on dark mode within the app setting. Happy to update this review when these bugs have been squashed. Don’t break what works with unnecessary updates!

reviews.title: Latest Update 5/26/2026 Broke It
reviews.text: The recently released update to the “Guardian Editions” app does NOT work.  On my Apple iPad, this app’s prior version worked fine a few days ago. Today (5/27/2026),  the app fails(it just starts, displays a blank screen with the dreaded spinning icon.

reviews.title: Overcharged on a subscription
reviews.text:
I got massively overcharged on a subscription offer.
I was trying to resubscribe after my annual subscription lapsed but when I clicked to accept the offer I got charged full price costing me more than £40 more.
My credit card got deducted full price.
The online chat was no help.
I suggest you don't use the app and to subscribe through the web browser.
The app is full of errors anyway. The games hardly ever work and I am on the latest IOS version on iPhone.

reviews.title: Another sign in App
reviews.text: Had to dump this one too!  They went to a sign in so they can collect your information and then email and text you!  Good bye

reviews.title: Freezes all the time
reviews.text: Recent update means on iPhone and iPad the app crashes to frozen state when you go to the puzzles.

reviews.title: Fluffed it
reviews.text:
I was enjoying this app, but alas I’m now required to sign in…
I don’t need yet another login. Thanks but no thank you.

reviews.title: Will not work
reviews.text: I used to love the My Guardian feature which allowed me to follow topics or specific journalists. I have tried every which way but cannot sign in to this App. I can sign in from browser (but there is no My Guardian on browser), and I can still access Editions App!

reviews.title: Anti Starmer bias
reviews.text: Very disappointed with the editorial bias and campaign against the PM. It’s very obvious and quite boring now.

reviews.title: Crashes all the time
reviews.text: I like the app normally, but over the last few weeks the app crashes daily. I have the most recent update.

reviews.title: Puzzles keep disappearing
reviews.text: One minute everything’s fine, the next puzzles won’t load or are not showing. Sometimes get an error about internet connectivity but that is definitely not the issue

reviews.title: Selling your data now
reviews.text: Suddenly requires you to sign in to view news articles. Already seeing ads so you can only assume it is to sell your data. Makes you wonder what else is being sold out. So much for integrity and keeping people informed. Uninstalled.

reviews.title: App review.
reviews.text: The app works ok for me apart from the weekly Error 1560 in the puzzles. Two weekend crosswords never work. Week in week out. Clear cached data. Reinstall app. Nope! Come on devs. Sort it out!

reviews.title: Watch out
reviews.text: Love Guardian coverage and insight.it’s the app that needs caution. However if you pay for a sub within this app, you cannot use your access with an android device  (something that is not made clear when you pay for sub within app.) likewise if you subscribe within the app downloaded from google play, you cannot use access on iOS devices. This the management calls “third party subscription” and will not refund if done in error. Makes one consider not subscribing at all.

reviews.title: Not fixed in 3 months
reviews.text: So following on from my review in early January we have had several updates including fixes to the crosswords. Today is the 9th April and the puzzles are still broken. Randomly when select a clue to fill in it fills the screen with yellow so you CAN’T see what you’re typing. This lack of progress coupled with the higher subscription costs has finally lead me to cancel.

reviews.title: Where did Dark Mode go?
reviews.text: The latest update removed the ability to set the Guardian app to appear in a “Dark Mode”setting. Very disappointing. Please bring it back.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: I’m a fan of the journalism, but the rush towards animation seems to make the app unstable - it is forever crashing, freezing , buffering or building . I have a current iPhone and the software is up to date. If I wanted audio or video content, I’d listen to an app or go to the BBC …..

reviews.title: Pop ups on startup
reviews.text: Generally I have found this an easy app to use but in the last week or so every time I start the app it asks me to sign up to sports or other notifications. Why can this not be stopped permanently? It is very very annoying.

reviews.title: Crosswords STILL Flakey
reviews.text:
I frequently have problems with the crosswords failing to load - Error Code 1560 and a string of errors:-

1570: NSValidationMissngMandatoryPropertyError - non-optional property with nil value

I know someone else who has problems with crosswords not loading. These problems have existed for MONTHS. Why can’t the devs spend a little time fixing problems as well as making constant interface changes. It’s the only app which I use a lot that I have frequent problems with - requiring yet another delete/reinstall cycle (& loss of all crossword history). Please please FIX!

reviews.title: Problem with crosswords
reviews.text: I am a visually impaired user. I have been using The Guardian with VoiceOver on iPhone and iPad for a number of years the latest release four days ago 19th of March has absolutely done something to crosswords and the crosswords for a are an inaccessible and very problematic using VoiceOver with iPhone and iPad please can you fix it?

reviews.title: Crashes nonstop
reviews.text: Latest iPadOS

reviews.title: App not working
reviews.text: There’s nothing wrong with the app on my iPhone 17ProMax. When to touch the app it just turns off. It doesn’t connect. It was doing that a few days ago and then came back. But now it’s down again. Anyone else experiencing this?

reviews.title: App won’t open
reviews.text: App won’t open on my iPhone after the last update.

reviews.title: App not working
reviews.text: Since most recent update, APP won’t open. The area on the APP page where you should be able to get help is also not working. Please fix!

reviews.title: Useless -  mandatory sign-in
reviews.text: I’d kept a subscription going to support one of the few non-rubbish news sources, but it seems they will prioritise customer profiling and the generation of marketing intelligence in their cash flow model so maybe they don’t need subscribers.  Apparently you can be the customer *and* the product at the same time.  I’ve cancelled my subscription.  Sadly, that still means last 8 month of subscription down the drain.  You can read headlines.  Then again, you don't need the app for that.  C-.  Update: even after dropping your subscription and deleting the app, they will send you mails (forwarded by apple)

reviews.title: App crashes and there is no way to report it
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years. I have the latest version. I have the latest version of my iPhone. As of about two hours ago, the app started crashing. You cannot contact support without using the app, but you cannot access the app to contact support. Other than the fact that I can’t use it it’s a nice app.

reviews.title: App constantly locks up and stops scrolling
reviews.text: You have to keep restarting the app to read stories.

reviews.title: Account
reviews.text: Now requires you to sign in with Google to read an article

reviews.title: Articles because ming ever more divisive
reviews.text: On students at York university complaining about ‘southerners ‘ making them feel estranged is absolute nonsense and made me very angry. Britain and its higher education system is open to all able to accomplish the necessary ‘A’ level grades. .  Why are the northerners complaining as if it is their god given right to hold sway ? I’m appalled. I was a York university student in the late 70s and the delight was the huge mixture of regional accents yet the same focus of academic enquiry. Why create cultural divisions which are nothing but hostile and destructive to the nature of intellectual pursuit.
